The role of cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) in evaluating congenital heart disease continues to expand. This app aims to provide a day-to-day companion for those new to congenital CMR and for those looking for a quick reference guide in routine practice. The app gives an overview of the most common abnormalities and interventions as well as post-operative complications. It also provides typical scan protocols, key issues and a guide for reporting for each topic.

One of the most popular features of the renowned CMR Pocket Guide app by Herzog, Greenwood & Plein, the CMR Calculator, has now been made available as a dedicated, stand-alone app for iPhone and iPad. 

This app contains a set of five calculators to estimate heart chamber volumes from MRI data,  and extra-cellular volume in the myocardium from T1 measurements. Normal value databases are integrated in the calculators, and interactively indicate normal values based on age and sex. Contains integrated info pages and references.

ABG Expert™ is simply the best acid-base analysis tool with features available in no other app. Designed and tested by practicing physicians, ABG Expert is trusted by medical professionals for unparalleled accuracy, flexibility, and power while remaining completely intuitive to use. 


Whether you are a physician, nurse, respiratory therapist, paramedic, or student, ABG Expert is your ideal acid base analysis app.

• No need to worry about entering physiologically impossible data by mistake. Data is checked for plausibility and for internal consistency using the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation.

• Never again wonder about how a result was obtained. Detailed explanations include easy-to-understand equations so you can be sure the calculations are correct. 


Flexibility- 

• Need the arterial blood gas analysis, but not the anion gap or A-a gradient? No problem. ABG Expert can analyze the data for all three results separately or together.

• Need more specificity? Adjust the normal delta gap range based on the literature you follow in your practice.

Power-
